in_text_mentions: Flexible bronchoscopy was performed which revealed significant narrowing of the tracheal lumen from these osseous protrusions throughout the length of the trachea starting from the subglottic space and extending up to right and left mainstem bronchus. The key finding in bronchoscopy was the sparing of the posterior wall of the trachea (Figure 3).
